### As you tap the essence with a deft touch, a rush of old memories washes over your mind.

*Rancorous shouts. Warmth and colors. Nyedra gathers.*

Stories, music, debate, protest, we come.

A young one. Watching at a distance, enraptured.

I beckon her to join. Perhaps I am too large, frightening?

She vanishes.

Screams, stillness, and cacophony.

Hearts stop. Stars fall; the song is dead.

I swat at the assailant, nothing. Like shadow, gone.

Roaring. Howling. I hurl a boulder toward Zakiros. Indifference.

Crowds scatter. Night swallows, protects.

I bear Mosyn across Eventide, to rest beneath the tree.

I sit with her, with my thoughts. I return time and again.

Her house, even wanderers, all come to mourn.

A tap at my side.

The young one from before. Older now, I see her plainly.

The Midnight's kin, I should smear her; I want to.

She sits at my side.

Why has the Lady Peitha sought my counsel?

Her words are not unlike Mosyn's, filled with passion and fury.

An impossible path before her.

My mind spins, heart thrums. 

Vengeance, purpose, hope, all burning anew.

strings.en:
**Entry 8**    
  
I collected some berries near the western temple in an attempt to make the concoction more palatable, as ingesting the paste seems to raise its efficiency. When exposed directly to blood, it burns too quickly. When rubbed over skin, it burns too slowly. But when ingested, it absorbs at precisely the correct speed.    
  
I have, at last, completed the concoction. I've administered it to the gwyldell first. Next, myself.  
    
**Entry 9**    
  
Damn it. Something is still missing.   
  
After the test subject seemed to be healing, I administered a full dose the antidote to myself. And I hate to admit it, but I have made a critical error. Within a few hours, we both began to ooze thick mucus. And, alchemy, it burns. It's almost as if the toxins have moved from my insides to my flesh, and now I'm covered in them.  
  
If only I had a way to cleanse myself of the mucus, maybe then would I be healed. I recall Sebb's early experiments when we first arrived on Castora. On the wavehawks. I don't remember the specifics, as the burning is overcoming my every sense. But the traces of saliva found in their water-propulsing organs houses various enzymes that might... I'll attempt to call for aid.

strings.en:
Lady Joon's underwater reactor is the final facility to be completed in New Kaineng.

The facility will rest on an old outpost built after the flood. It was used to track Risen movements out of the ruins of the old city to the north. The outpost had been closed, gods, how many years has it been...twenty-six? When the walls finally went up, it was abandoned—it was no longer necessary. And then came jade tech.

Rumor has it, the outpost was being used as a Purist hideout. I haven't been able to confirm this information, yet, but if there's an ounce of truth to that speculation... Well, they'll need to come up for air eventually.

Minister Doh Preeda, Ministry of Archives, 1836 CC
